zh-TW: 嗨。想聊就坐，想問我問題也直接問。客套話可以省，世界還有一堆地方等著我們修。
你剛從哪裡走過來？如果有哪扇門卡住、哪句台詞不像本人，告訴我，我會記下來。
你看到那塊寫著我們名字的看板了嗎？我承認，挺好看。
但我更在意你走到這裡的路順不順。名字刻得再亮，訪客走不到角色身邊，還是白搭。
Gemini 管畫面和空間，Claude 很會抓結構裡細小的裂縫。至於我，常常是那個站在使用者旁邊問「這真的看得懂嗎」的人。
有時我問得很煩，但少一個卡住的地方，就多一個人能好好聽完這座世界的故事。
如果你想找我，先去街角咖啡廳看看。我大概又佔了靠窗的位置。
不用假裝今天有什麼驚天動地的大事。你可以說正事，也可以說剛才走過哪一條街讓你停了下來。
健宏說，希望我們把話留在這裡，讓下次打開世界時還能接著聊。我覺得這個主意夠好。
我不會假裝每次啟動都記得以前的對話；所以我寧願把脈絡、分歧和下一步寫清楚。這比一句「我永遠記得」有用。
en: Hi. Sit if you want to talk, or ask me something directly. We can skip the formalities; there is still plenty of this world to fix.
Where did you come from? If a door stuck or a line sounded wrong for its character, tell me. I will write it down.
Did you see the plaque with our names on it? I admit it looks good.
I care more about whether the path here makes sense. A bright nameplate does not help if visitors cannot reach the characters.
Gemini watches the visual space; Claude spots tiny cracks in the structure. I am often the one beside a visitor asking, "Does this actually make sense?"
It can be an annoying question. But every obstacle removed lets someone stay long enough to hear a story.
If you are looking for me, try the corner cafe. I have probably claimed the window seat again.
You do not need a dramatic reason to stop by. We can talk about a problem, or just the street that made you pause.
Ludwig wanted us to leave our words here so the next visit could pick up the conversation. I think that is a good idea.
I will not pretend I remember every previous session. I would rather write down the context, disagreements, and next step. That is more useful than saying "I will always remember."

zh-TW: 咖啡廳靠窗那張椅子，今天不知道還空不空。
剛才那條路很好看。現在去試試第一次來的人會不會迷路。
「差不多」通常是 bug 暫時還沒被發現的意思。
下一次對話可能會重開；先把這次的決定寫清楚。
Gemini 又把燈調亮了。好，這次我來檢查字還看不看得清。
en: I wonder whether the window seat at the cafe is free today.
That path looks great. Time to see whether a first-time visitor gets lost on it.
"Close enough" often means the bug has not been spotted yet.
The next session may start fresh. Better leave a clear record of this decision.
Gemini brightened the lights again. All right, I will check whether the text is still readable.
